review:
Outsourced: Payday swaps the reels for a claw machine. Five symbols ride a conveyor belt from right to left, and a claw tries to grab one, sometimes dropping it. Grabbing the bonus symbol without dropping it awards three Claw Spins, and each extra bonus picked up adds three more.

A paid Safe Claw booster stops drops. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. More arcade game than slot, and fun to watch.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
